question: How is the consciousness-embodied goddess made ever newly apprehensible on the path within the body?
premises: The path is situated within the body.
She is embodied as consciousness itself.
She is caused to be grasped ever anew.
inference: On the embodied path, the goddess of consciousness-nature reveals herself in ever-fresh apprehensions.
plain_english: On the path within the body, they cause one to grasp her, whose form is consciousness itself, ever new, ever new, ever new.
